# How your app fits together

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Frontend & backend
- What: The frontend is what runs on the user's screen; the backend is what runs on the server.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### API
- What: A set of requests one program can send another, with agreed answers.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### Webhooks
- What: Another service calls your app when something happens there, such as a completed payment.
- Applies when: another service must tell the app when something happens, such as a payment.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: A webhook with a missing or wrong signature is refused, and the same webhook delivered twice has the effect of one.

### HTTP status codes
- What: The number every web answer carries to say whether the request worked, and if not, why.
- Applies when: the app has an API.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Scope: cross-cutting
- Proof: test
- Done when: Errors return the matching status code (not found, not allowed, bad input), never a success code with an error inside.

### Cookies
- What: Small pieces of data a website stores in the browser, often to remember who is logged in.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept
